attribs.name: repeating_traits_-OCx9tZR8l02o02VCJPi_description
attribs.current:
The Man-o'-Arms is a fanatic when it comes to weapons and their wielding. They are capable of holding using and exploiting multiple of them at the same time with a combination of preparation, smarts and finger-finesse.

Weapon Maintainance[–] When you choose this archetype at 3rd level, you gain proficiency in two of the following tools of your choice: smith's tools, tinker's tools, leatherworkers's tools or woodcarver's tools.

Weapon Proficiency[–] You gain proficiency in either Firearms or two Exotic weapons of your choice.

Battle Ready[–] Your dexterity with mastered weapons improves to accomodate two of them effectively in combat. While wielding a one-handed mastered weapon and a light mastered weapon, after you take the Attack you can make another attack with a bonus action.

You may load ammunition for a one-handed ranged mastered weapon without a free hand once per turn this way.

Additionally, being within 5 feet of a hostile creature doesn't impose disadvantage on your ranged attack rolls.

attribs.name: repeating_traits_-OCx9tZavlnUKOxTBLR6_description
attribs.current:
At the 7th level, in conjunction with your improved handling of weapons, you've devised a system of sheaths, quivers, bandoleers and other such quick-access storage around you such that you always have the weapon you need at the right time. You gain the following benefits:-

- You can a bonus action attack after an Attack action if you are wielding two mastered weapons without the Two-Handed or Heavy properties.

- Once per turn, as part of an attack, you can quickly sheath a mastered weapon you're holding, replace it with a different mastered weapon in your inventory and attack with it. If the weapon being swapped in has the Two-Handed property or if you want to use it's Versatile property, you must have a free hand to make an attack.

- You ignore the Loading property of mastered weapons.

- You no longer need a free hand to load ammunition into one-handed mastered weapons.

- A number of weapons you carry equal to your proficiency bonus have their weight reduced by half.

attribs.name: repeating_traits_-OCx9tZeoUGTGXxkmwfd_description
attribs.current: When you make a weapon attack, you can impart a weapon mastery property of a weapon used prior that turn. You must have mastered all weapons involved in this feature.

attribs.name: repeating_traits_-OCxA7F2-GZQdHgUDTok_description
attribs.current:
You have a limited well of stamina that you can draw on to protect yourself from harm. On your turn, you can use a bonus action to regain hit points equal to 1d10 + your fighter level.

You can use this feature twice, and you regain all expended uses whenever you finish a long rest. You gain more uses of this feature, as shown in the Second Wind column of the Fighter table.

attribs.name: repeating_traits_-OCxA7F5lFGtXNj6mFoI_description
attribs.current:
Starting at 2nd level, you can push yourself beyond your normal limits for a moment. On your turn, you can take one additional action.

Once you use this feature, you must finish a short or long rest before you can use it again. Starting at 17th level, you can use it twice before a rest, but only once on the same turn.

attribs.name: repeating_traits_-OCxA7F9180p1d1AjPOF_description
attribs.current:
You have a mind for tactics and getting the upper hand on and off the battlefield. Beginning at 2nd level, whenever you fail an ability check, you can expend a use of your Second Wind to push yourself towards success.

Rather than regaining Hit Points, you roll 1d10 and add the number rolled to the ability check, potentially turning it into a success. If the check still fails, this use of Second Wind isn't expended.

attribs.name: repeating_traits_-OCxA7FCWDM47eUvZ7ni_description
attribs.current:
Starting at 4th level, Your training with weapons allows you to use the mastery property of three kinds of Simple or Martial weapons of your choice. Whenever you finish a Long rest, you can practice weapon drills and change one of those weapon choices.

Masteries: Vex, Nick, Sap

attribs.name: repeating_traits_-OCxA7FM6Zkenr94x47T_description
attribs.current: at 5th level, whenever you activate your Second Wind with a bonus action, you can move up to half your speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks.

attribs.name: repeating_traits_-OCxA7FPZh21fxZQ8ZGU_description
attribs.current: Beginning at 9th level, you can reroll a saving throw that you fail with a bonus equal to your fighter level. If you do so, you must use the new roll, and you can't use this feature again until you finish a long rest.

attribs.name: repeating_traits_-OCxA7FRZzX9gFWO5LN9_description
attribs.current: At 11th level, you can attack three times whenever you take the Attack action on your turn.

attribs.name: repeating_traits_-OCxCr-AUVI2lTmGpXJH_description
attribs.current: When you engage in two-weapon fighting, you can add your ability modifier to the damage of the second attack.

attribs.name: repeating_traits_-OCxPUBhbgZmLQRyBZN0_description
attribs.current:
You have undergone extensive physical training to gain the following benefits:

- When you are prone, standing up uses only 5 feet of your movement.

- Climbing doesn't cost you extra movement.

- You can make a running long jump or a running high jump after moving only 5 feet on foot, rather than 10 feet.

attribs.name: repeating_traits_-OCxPUWzanHWDDzDwPbU_description
attribs.current:
Your exposure to the Feywild's magic has changed you, granting you the following benefits:

- You learn the misty step spell and one 1st-level spell of your choice. The 1st-level spell must be from the divination or enchantment school of magic. You can cast each of these spells without expending a spell slot. Once you cast either of these spells in this way, you can't cast that spell in this way again until you finish a long rest. You can also cast these spells using spell slots you have of the appropriate level. The spells' spellcasting ability is the ability increased by this feat.

attribs.name: repeating_traits_-OCxPUr2AcdtKWwsrZvk_description
attribs.current:
You've manifested some of the power of chromatic dragons, granting you the following benefits:

- Chromatic Infusion. As a bonus action, you can touch a simple or martial weapon and infuse it with one of the following damage types: acid, cold, fire, lightning, or poison. For the next minute, the weapon deals an extra 1d4 damage of the chosen type when it hits. After you use this bonus action, you can't do so again until you finish a long rest.

- Reactive Resistance. When you take acid, cold, fire, lightning, or poison damage, you can use your reaction to give yourself resistance to that instance of damage. You can use this reaction a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest.

attribs.name: repeating_traits_-OCxPbirkjsp9dZb79Ks_description
attribs.current:
A drive for perfection may be futile, but not fruitless. The precision you act with grants you an advantage over your opponents:

- Your critical hit range increases by 1 for attack rolls. Apply this after any features that may improve your critical hit range.

attribs.name: repeating_spell-1_-OCxPkp1465y23ncR1vR_spellathigherlevels
attribs.current: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd or 4th level, you can maintain your concentration on the spell for up to 8 hours. When you use a spell slot of 5th level or higher, you can maintain your concentration on the spell for up to 24 hours.

attribs.name: repeating_spell-1_-OCxPkp1465y23ncR1vR_spelldescription
attribs.current: You choose a creature you can see within range and mystically mark it as your quarry. Until the spell ends, you deal an extra 1d6 damage to the target whenever you hit it with a weapon attack, and you have advantage on any Wisdom (Perception) or Wisdom (Survival) check you make to find it. If the target drops to 0 hit points before this spell ends, you can use a bonus action on a subsequent turn of yours to mark a new creature.

attribs.name: repeating_spell-2_-OCxPl4GTXTRKeA64PNQ_spelldescription
attribs.current: Briefly surrounded by silvery mist, you teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space that you can see.

attribs.name: repeating_traits_-OCxW4RNtqNEPZVTazP0_description
attribs.current: You are in frequent contact with people in the segment of society that your chosen quarries move through. These people might be associated with the criminal underworld, the rough-and-tumble folk of the streets, or members of high society. This connection comes in the form of a contact in any city you visit, a person who provides information about the people and places of the local area.

attribs.name: repeating_traits_-OCxeCHjG05MSMvu6rZk_description
attribs.current:
Your unique training method gives you accuracy only matched by the greatest of elves. You have uncanny aim with attacks that rely on precision rather than brute force. You gain the following benefits:

- Whenever you have advantage on an attack roll using Dexterity, Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma, you can reroll one of the dice once.

attribs.name: character_backstory
attribs.current:
You are a member of the Departed Outlaws, who has been called out in the dire times of need 


The history of the guild of outlaws is known to you 
You were one of the strongest guilds in the region until the members were sent to the war and were killed by a vile necromancer. 
Seeing the fellow towns folk all die ,the town despises the guild and does not encourage anyone partaking in its businesses.
You are one of the few members who stuck with the guild and one of the few survivors from the necromancer's rampage (Vylnowa is the necromancer's name).
Yi shing mao was a comrade in this war
Leading a low life in the city of Doport itself you were called into the guild the current morning. 
Upon arriving you are ambushed by few Underhand members while you are being debriefed about the current task. 
Aid WEBEBUSSIN- party name , in procuring the final item for the summoning ritual by the Underhand. 
You along with the Saint Gerald and the other members, Slaughter all the underhand members and gain information from Aldrin
